answer: With exponential temporal decay, reputation halves at each fixed interval, so an identity must provide sustained, reciprocal honest service to retain influence. A sybil swarm cannot forge history by creating many accounts: fresh nodes start with near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality, and weakly connected, untrusted links contribute little through reciprocity-weighted transitivity. Thus names such as tundra or beacon confer no shortcut; these identities cannot reach consensus thresholds without earned trust.
